_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact, and WITHOUT the customary split50 structural residual. The pre-2022 sheet only requires the <=$50 half to be reported as an AGGREGATE, so on every other split50 filing in this wave the ledger reproduces the >$50 box and the residual against the stated total IS that aggregate. THIS FILER ITEMIZED BOTH HALVES: he filled a second ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT sheet, hand-headed it '$50.00 & less', and listed all 18 small donors by name, date, address and amount. p5's 15 rows = 4,180.00 = the printed '>$50' box; p7's 18 rows = 280.00 = the printed '<=$50' box; 4,180.00 + 280.00 = 4,460.00 = the module's stated total. Both sheets print the SAME pair of boxes, so each sheet's own arithmetic was checked against both. Specimen row 'Jon and Jane Doe / PO Box 128, Coalville, UT 84017 / $435.00' appears on BOTH sheets and is dropped from both; the printed boxes close only without it. No in-kind schedule exists on this filing.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of exactly $40.00, and it is the FILER'S ARITHMETIC, retained as filed and never repaired. The 34 expense rows sum to 3,691.09 against the schedule's own boxed total of $3,651.09, which is also the cover figure. ESCALATION BEFORE ACCEPTING IT: the whole Amount column was re-read as two tight column crops at 900 dpi, the first row and the total box at 1000 dpi. Every one of the 34 amounts re-read identically, and the total box is unambiguously 3651.09. The delta is a round $40 with no single candidate digit - 605.00->565.00, 93.94->53.94, 86.98->46.98, 281.00->241.00, 450.00->410.00 and 66.00->26.00 would each close it - so there is nothing for the arithmetic to decide and the honest record is the filer's own inconsistency (GOTCHAS: escalation resolves legibility, never truth). The filer's own balance corroborates that HIS total, not the column, is what he carried forward: 4,460.00 - 3,651.09 = 808.91, exactly the printed campaign balance. Specimen row 'Name of Business / Campaign signs and flyers / $512.00' dropped.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: NINE pages, and only FOUR carry anything. Page-by-page classification (the prep scan reported bands=0 on p2/p4/p6/p9 and that is CORRECT, not a detection failure): p2 BLANK verso (fold creases only); p3 a SECOND, PHOTOCOPIED COPY OF THE COVER - same figures, same signature, same 'Oct 22, 2014' date as the born-digital p1 the module already transcribed, re-read at 200 dpi to confirm it is a duplicate and not an amendment, and NOT re-read for money; p4 BLANK verso; p5 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT hand-headed 'over $50.00'; p6 BLANK verso (p5's bleed-through, mirror-imaged); p7 a SECOND ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT hand-headed '$50.00 & less'; p8 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT; p9 BLANK verso (p8's bleed-through). CONTRIBUTION GATE: p5 prints both boxes, '>$50 $4,180.00' and '<=$50 $280.00'; its 15 rows sum to 4,180.00 to the cent and p7's 18 rows sum to 280.00 to the cent, so the two sheets together reproduce BOTH boxes and their sum equals the module's stated 4,460.00 exactly. EXPENSE GATE: p8 prints 'Total amount of expenditures $3651.09' (re-read at 1000 dpi) and the cover carries the same figure; the 34 rows sum to 3,691.09 - a $40.00 filer delta, see recon.expenditures. Both printed SPECIMEN rows are dropped and the arithmetic is the proof: keeping them would give 4,615.00 on p5, 715.00 on p7 and 4,203.09 on p8, and no box would close.

_meta_itemized.notes: Krisden Boyington Hendricksen ('Kris B. Hendricksen' on the signature line), County Sheriff, 2014 Pre-Election, signed Oct 22 2014. split50 form, handwritten throughout, photocopied and scanned duplex so that four of the nine pages are blank versos. SOURCE PROPERTIES THIS BRIEF DID NOT LIST - two are precedent candidates: (1) A FILER CAN ITEMIZE THE <=$50 AGGREGATE ON A SECOND CONTRIBUTION SHEET. The wave's established structural rule - 'the ledger itemizes only the >$50 donors and the residual against the stated total is exactly the <=$50 aggregate' - has a real exception on the file. Hendricksen filled TWO ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT sheets and hand-wrote the scope at the top of each, 'over $50.00' on one and '$50.00 & less' on the other; the second sheet names all 18 small donors and closes the $280.00 box to the cent. So a split50 filing with NO residual is not evidence of a missing box - it can mean the filer volunteered the aggregate's detail. (Note the related 1244 Brock precedent, where the <=$50 box was itemized as two anonymised '$50 or less donor' lines on the SAME sheet; this is the fuller form of the same behaviour.) (2) THE DOCUMENT CARRIES ITS COVER TWICE. p3 is a photocopy of the p1 cover, identical in every figure and in the signature date. It is neither an amendment nor a second report; it is the filer's own copy scanned into the same bundle. Page position is not a classifier, and neither is 'page 1 is the cover' - a second cover can appear mid-document. (3) THE COUNTY'S PUBLISHED COPY CARRIES ORANGE/PINK HIGHLIGHTER TICKS in the right margin of p7, against about ten of the small-donor rows. They are a reader's marks (a check-off pass over the <=$50 list), carry no value and change no figure; recorded here because they are visible on the published image and might otherwise be read as data. (4) THE EXPENSE LEDGER IS NOT IN DATE ORDER (4-11-14 sits after 5-12-14, 6-30-14 after 7-2-14, 8-19-14 after 8-28-14). Every date is well formed, so all are kept verbatim; none is a needs_review case under the strict-date rule. PRIVACY: both contribution sheets print a full Mailing Address and a Zipcode column. Street addresses and PO boxes were discarded AT READ TIME and are nowhere in this record; only donor_city and donor_state are kept, and the city is read from the address cell, NEVER inferred from the zip. Two cities are expanded from the filer's abbreviations, 'Pl. Grove' -> Pleasant Grove and 'Am fork' -> American Fork; every other city is as written. Nothing on this filing is redacted - the county published it unmarked (the black-marker redaction era starts in 2022). GEOMETRY - and a TOOL LIMITATION worth reporting. The two contribution sheets are the same printed form but sit OUT OF PHASE on the scan: p5's first data row starts at y=28.29% with a measured pitch of 1.9307%, p7's at y=23.89% with a pitch of 1.9200% (both fitted to the pages' own rules and each validated by two probe crops). The offset is 4.40%, i.e. 2.29 row pitches - not an integer number of rows - so NO SINGLE declared table_frame can serve both pages, and make_itemized_caches.py takes one frame per SIDE, not per page. The contributions side is therefore left on the MEASURED path so each page uses its own detected rules: p7's 18 rows resolve to full-width boxes (p7 registered no vertical rules, so x/w come from the declared frame) and every one was spot-verified; p5's boxes are correct in y but are bounded by that page's outermost DETECTED vertical rule at 79.25%, the Zipcode|Amount separator, because the sheet's right border did not register - so a p5 crop shows date/donor/address/zip but not the amount. p5 rows 3 and 4 share detected band 3, whose rule the filer's ink crossed; their box contains both rows. The expenditures side is single-page and uses a DECLARED frame (force_declared, x=8.51 y0=17.31 pitch=1.9142 w=83.13), fitted to p8's own rules measured in three separate x-slices of the RAW page and validated by four probe crops (band 2 = Summit County 605.00, band 15 = Walmart 15.53, band 25 = Sign Depot 400.00, band 35 = Park Record 499.00); band 1 is the dropped specimen row. On p5 and p8 the SHADED header and specimen rows produce a spurious rule inside the shading, which is why the naive first band is ~0.6-1.0% off the true grid - the grids here were fitted to the unshaded rules and then probe-verified, not taken from the first detected band.
